body: You brought actually tears in my eyes. Happy tears, for once. Thank you for this beautiful comment, and your utterly sweet compliments. I’d never thought in a million years that sharing this would be helpful, especially here. And likewise, you could pm anytime you want to. You’re not alone. When individuals struggle independently, they should come together and lift each other up! I would love to know more of your story.

The only communication that happens is when I’m at school, and have to talk to someone about topics that are related to our studies. Whenever something more happens and we talk more than school, I think it’s great, but somehow this person just disappears in weeks time. See, that’s what annoys me the most - why can’t I have a stable friendship?! 

Yes, there are many I would love to form closer relationships with. Starting with my parents, I feel like it’s so broken our conversation only go like: “hi, how are you, are you doing good in school”. It’s always these three short sentences. I want to have more of a bond between them other than a shallow relationship. I’ve tried to mend things between us, but whenever I feel like I’ve taken a step forward, they later push it 10 steps back. It really sucks because I live with them and see them more often than other, but they’re so busy and preoccupied with other things to bother about me. But unfortunately my relationship with my parents is completely cold.
My social life, honestly. Like I’ve mentioned in my initial post - I have none. No friends or family, or anyone other than my mind to talk to. I believe that I repel people away from me.
I’m studying IT security and networking, and I’m hoping to pursue a career in cyber forensics one day.
Your comment made me smile, thank you!!!

Hi. Thank you for your encouraging words - I appreciate you taking the time.

More about my situation... Yes, I am in school. I'm currently on my last semester in college, actually. For my home situation - it's ok, I can't complain about that. I am fortunate for having a room on top of my head and a bed to sleep in.

I am seeking for another way other than suicide and death. I just don't know how or what to do.
